title: ForgeCycle Builder result front matter
description: Describes the stored artifact. On input, ForgeCycle fills schema_version, run_id, turn, base_revision, head_revision, and each required test's command when omitted, expands abbreviated revisions, and rewrites equivalent required-test commands to the exact required string (ADR 0016, ADR 0018). Status completed requires every test passed, except that gated and after-gate tests may be not_run (ADR 0023, ADR 0037); failing or other not_run tests are reported under partial.

status.description: completed only when every test passed

after_gate.description: Ignored: the required test's definition decides; a test that runs after the gates may be not_run under completed (ADR 0037)
